old: — electron microscopy, g-ratio, myelinated and unmyelinated axon counts, conduction latency and the CNP/MBP intensity and CC1+/PDGFRalpha+ counts are the neuronal `S-KO`'s (Figs 4-5); the RNA-level myelin readouts are the constitutive null's and the `N-KO`'s; the OPC co-culture is the constitutive null's dorsal-root-ganglion neurons; the remaining ones are the human oligocortical spheroids'.
new: — corrected 2026-11-28 (`BATCH_20261128_011`; independent second reader on the article and supplement of PMID 33914858; replaces the attribution of the electron-microscopy and CC1+/PDGFRalpha+ endpoints to the neuronal `S-KO` alone and of the RNA-level readouts to the null and the `N-KO` alone): **`S-KO`**: electron-microscopy myelinated-axon counts (corpus callosum), unmyelinated-axon counts (optic nerve) and g-ratio (both) at P17, evoked-response N1 latency (longer; N2 not significant) and N1/N2 amplitude ratio (Fig 5), CNP/MBP intensity and CC1+/PDGFRalpha+ counts (Fig 4), CC1+NG2+ counts (Suppl Fig 6B,D) and transcripts (cortex qRT-PCR, Suppl Fig 5C; bulk RNA-seq and a 1-vs-1 single-nucleus RNA-seq, Fig 3); **`N-KO`**: myelinated-axon (corpus callosum) and unmyelinated-axon (optic nerve) counts per field (Suppl Fig 5G; legend n = 3 per genotype, but the plotted points are fields, not animals) and cortex qRT-PCR (Suppl Fig 5H); **constitutive null**: CC1+ and PDGFRalpha+ cell counts in corpus callosum at P17 (Suppl Fig 7F; legend n = 3, unit ambiguous between mice and sections) and cortex qRT-PCR (Suppl Fig 7D); the hippocampal RNA-seq of Suppl Fig 4 spans the null, `N-KO` and `S-KO`; the OPC co-culture (wild-type OPCs) uses constitutive-null dorsal-root-ganglion neurons; the human oligocortical spheroids add a percentage of myelinated axons (Fig 7I, week 37, 2 vs 3, no statistic) and qPCR (Suppl Fig 9D), their stains (Fig 7E-G) being images only.
